decision.scope: All twelve Chapters and all three language levels of Pinocchio v3
decision.reason: The Golden Chapter established the warm, clear, emotionally present storybook performance selected for this title.

productionWindow.rule: Finish the approved masters and any pickups before the internal deadline; do not rely on future regeneration from this voice.

assetPolicy.futureCorrections: Create a versioned replacement master with an approved available voice; never silently overwrite a published Lily master.

futureVoiceChoice.maleAlternative: Darian may be evaluated later as an optional user-selectable narrator pack.
futureVoiceChoice.newTitles: Choose an available narrator per title and keep the immutable voice ID in that Story Pack.
